notes.title: Game Update! 5 new languages + Steam Deck compatibility + Steam Cloud Save ✨
notes.notes:
Hi Night Explorers!
It’s been a while since our release, but today we’re excited to bring you some fantastic new updates for Night Reverie! Here’s what’s new:

🌍 5 New Languages!
We're thrilled to expand our community with the addition of 5 new languages.
Special thanks to the localization team for making this possible:
- Korean - Jeewon Bae
- Japanese - On Takahashi and Shu Miyasaka
- Portuguese (Brazil) - Thiago Hilger
- German - Irena Boettcher, LQA by BSC Everest
- French - Valentina Varone (who also did the Italian localization!)

Now, more players around the world can immerse themselves in our heartwarming adventure!

✅ Steam Deck Verified 
You can now experience Night Reverie on the go! With controls and performance optimized for the Steam Deck.

☁️ Steam Cloud Save
Night Reverie save data is now safely stored in the steam cloud! Pick up right where you left off from any device, without worrying about losing your progress.

🐛 Fixed Minor Bugs
Our team has fixed some minor bugs to make your gameplay experience smoother. 

That wraps up our update 😄
Thank you for your feedback and support, as a small team, getting these updates out can be a bit challenging, especially adding so many new languages (our game has a lot of story content!). But after so much hard work and teamwork, we're super excited to share these improvements with you and we hope you keep enjoying Night Reverie across all platforms!


The Somber Pixel Team


💸Bonus Surprise - Steam Sale!  
As part of our update celebration, we're thrilled to announce that we are part of two Steam Sales: “Women-Led Games Showcase” & “Latin American Games Showcase”. You can now get Night Reverie for you or a friend with a 40% DISCOUNT!! (Our biggest discount yet!) Hurry, before this offer ends!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1254670/Night_Reverie/
